problem.passage:
Art historian Margit Voss has long argued that the Flemish painter Hendrick van Doorn deserves recognition as an innovator rather than a mere imitator of his more famous contemporaries. Voss points to van Doorn's treatment of shadow, which departed sharply from the flat, uniform darkness typical of his era's portraiture. Instead, van Doorn layered translucent glazes to create shadows that shifted subtly in hue depending on the light source depicted within the scene. Critics who dismissed van Doorn during his lifetime had access only to his early commissioned portraits, ______ Voss has spent much of her career examining the private sketchbooks van Doorn kept for decades, which reveal the experimental technique fully developed decades before it appeared in any painting attributed to his contemporaries.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
problem.stimulus: Art historian Margit Voss has long argued that the Flemish painter Hendrick van Doorn deserves recognition as an innovator rather than a mere imitator of his more famous contemporaries. Voss points to van Doorn's treatment of shadow, which departed sharply from the flat, uniform darkness typical of his era's portraiture. Instead, van Doorn layered translucent glazes to create shadows that shifted subtly in hue depending on the light source depicted within the scene. Critics who dismissed van Doorn during his lifetime had access only to his early commissioned portraits, ______ Voss has spent much of her career examining the private sketchbooks van Doorn kept for decades, which reveal the experimental technique fully developed decades before it appeared in any painting attributed to his contemporaries.
problem.question: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
options: and those sketchbooks were later destroyed in a fire that also damaged several of his commissioned portraits
whereas the sketchbooks that document his experimentation remained unknown to the public until Voss's research uncovered them
for the sketchbooks were widely circulated among his contemporaries long before his portraits gained attention
since his contemporaries had already mastered the same glazing technique before van Doorn began his career
problem.explanation: 두 절은 대조 관계다: 비평가들은 초기 초상화만 볼 수 있었지만(공개된 자료의 한계), 보스는 대중에게 알려지지 않았던 스케치북을 연구했다. 'whereas'는 이 대조를 정확히 나타내는 종속접속사이며, 뒤 절의 내용(스케치북이 대중에게 알려지지 않았다가 보스에 의해 발견됨)도 지문의 사실과 일치한다.
problem.evidenceSpan: Critics who dismissed van Doorn during his lifetime had access only to his early commissioned portraits, ______ Voss has spent much of her career examining the private sketchbooks van Doorn kept for decades
problem.answerRationale: 'whereas'는 비평가들이 접근할 수 있었던 자료(초기 초상화)와 보스가 연구한 자료(대중에게 알려지지 않았던 스케치북) 사이의 대조 관계를 정확한 종속접속사로 표현하여 앞뒤 절의 논리적 관계를 올바르게 연결한다.

difficultyReasons: 대조 관계(whereas)를 파악해야 하며 이는 두 문장 사이의 논리적 대비를 이해하는 1~2단계 추론
오답들이 지문 단어(스케치북, 동시대인, 기법)를 재활용해 표면적으로 그럴듯함
핵심은 시간관계와 공개 여부에 대한 정반대 진술을 구분하는 것으로 미묘함이 중간 수준
선택지 A는 지문과 무관한 내용이라 비교적 쉽게 배제 가능하나 C, D는 정반대 논리를 정확히 파악해야 배제 가능

distractors.plausibleBecause: 스케치북이 언급되고 화재 손상이라는 구체적 서사가 그럴듯해 보일 수 있음
distractors.matches: sketchbooks, commissioned portraits 라는 단어가 등장
distractors.whyWrong: 지문에 화재로 파괴되었다는 언급이 전혀 없고, 이후 문장에서 Voss가 실제로 그 스케치북을 조사했다고 하므로 파괴되었다는 것과 모순됨

distractors.plausibleBecause: 'for'가 이유를 나타내는 접속사로 자연스럽게 들릴 수 있고 스케치북과 동시대인이라는 단어가 등장해 그럴듯함
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 스케치북이 널리 유포되지 않았고 Voss의 연구로 비로소 알려졌다고 명시하므로, 동시대인들 사이에 널리 유포되었다는 것은 정반대 진술임

distractors.plausibleBecause: 'since'가 시간적 선후 관계를 나타내는 것처럼 보여 그럴듯하며 glazing technique이라는 핵심 어휘가 등장
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 van Doorn의 기법이 동시대인들보다 수십 년 앞서 있었다고 명시하므로, 동시대인들이 먼저 이를 습득했다는 것은 정반대 진술임
